headline: TBR @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 3.60 at TOR 3.49, with a projected total of 7.09. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: TBR moved +0.09 runs while TOR moved -0.74, changing the projected margin by +0.83 runs. The projected total fell -0.65, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Drew Rasmussen has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Kazuma Okamoto, Chandler Simpson, Daulton Varsho, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Davis Schneider, Lenyn Sosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
